title: Found a great deal? Save it with 2 keys ⭐ #Shorts
description:
Don't lose that page you just found. Bookmark it in a second with a simple keyboard shortcut.

⌨️ Windows: Ctrl + D, then Enter
🍎 Mac: Cmd + D, then Enter (iPhone Safari: Share, then Add Bookmark | Android Chrome: menu ⋮, then the star)

A bookmark saves the page address, not the price. Deals can still change or expire.

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔
